description.content: Generate Solutions/h2> After your infrastructure has made the queries to your content sources that Trip Ninja defined in /get-searches/, the generate-solutions/ endpoint will generate a set of optimal itineraries including the ideal markup on those itineraries and then return them to you. You can then present those itineraries on the front end of your platform to your customers. The /generate-solutions/ endpoint contains an optional metadata field that exists on each query that your infrastructure performs. This field contains any metadata that you want to pass in (branded fares, tax info, etc.). 1. Include Metadata Field If you choose to include the metadata field, we will pass you these values in a list inside the corresponding itinerary when we have finished generating the itineraries for the search. Pros -The benefit of this extra metadata data is that the response from the /generate-solutions/ endpoint will be ready to be displayed on the front end of your platform. Cons - This will inflate the request/response size considerably which can result in longer loading times. 2. Ignore MetaData Field In approach, your infrastructure will only send the required fields listed in our docs. Pros - This will result in a much smaller request/response. Cons - It will be up to your infrastructure and platform to process the data and add any additional metadata to the itineraries returned. !
